column1: # Migration number bands: which 4-digit prefixes each release line numbers its new migrations from.
# Read by scripts/check-migration-numbers.sh, scripts/lib/migration-overlap.py and the internal/db band tests.
#   first last  the band's prefix range. Every prefix below the first band is the closed pre-band sequence.
#   open        yes while the band takes new files on the branches below.
#   branches    comma-separated base-branch globs; the first is the line's own branch.
#   follows     the first prefix of the band that is complete before this band's first file exists, or -.
#               It counts only while that band's open column is no: while main still numbers from it, a new file
#               can land there after this band has started.
#               Two bands where neither follows the other can reach a database in either order.
#   tags        the tag glob of the line that owns the band: a byte-for-byte copy of one of its files is a
#               forward-port and keeps its number on any branch. - when no release line owns the band.
# The commit that opens 0.12 on main sets the 0400 row to no and the 0700 row to yes.
